description: Job offer comparison — Compare up to 6 job offers offline: base, bonus (percent or amount), equity per year with optional haircut, signing bonus (year 1 only), 401k match, stipend, health premium, PTO value and commute time cost valued at your hourly rate. Returns year-1 total comp, recurring comp, effective value, effective hourly rate (including commute hours), guaranteed vs at-risk share, rank and gap vs the best offer, with a tie warning under 3%. Params: offers (required: Name:base=150000,bonus=10%,equity=40000,match=4%,pto=20,commute=60,officeDays=3,premium=2400,signing=20000,stipend=1200,remote=true; separate offers with ;), equityHaircut (percent), hoursPerWeek. Price: $0.004 USDC (Base, via x402).
